description: We are RED ATLAS, building an interactive Martian map to explore where humans could live on Mars. We’re into space, technology, data, and creative problem-solving, and we want to turn complex NASA data into something useful and engaging. Looking for teammates in web development, AI/ML, data analysis, Mars/Earth science, UI/UX, design, and storytelling. Curiosity and initiative matter most.
summary: RED ATLAS is an interactive Mars exploration platform designed to make planetary science accessible through immersive visualization and scientific data. The project allows users to explore the Martian surface, understand its topography, and discover important geographical features such as mountains, valleys, impact craters, and plains. By combining planetary mapping and elevation data, RED ATLAS transforms complex scientific information into an intuitive exploration experience. Its purpose is to help users better understand the Martian environment, investigate its geological characteristics, and explore factors that may influence future human missions. RED ATLAS connects scientific discovery with interactive digital exploration.
details:
What does RED ATLAS do?

RED ATLAS is an interactive digital platform that allows users to explore Mars and understand its surface through scientific visualization.

The platform focuses on making planetary geographical information easier to understand by presenting Martian terrain and scientific mapping data in an accessible visual experience.

How does it work?

The project uses planetary mapping and elevation information to represent the Martian landscape. Users can explore the planet, navigate across different regions, and investigate its geographical characteristics.

The scientific foundation includes Mars topographic information from the Mars Global Surveyor's Mars Orbiter Laser Altimeter (MOLA) and Mars Express High Resolution Stereo Camera (HRSC) mapping products.

Benefits and intended impact

RED ATLAS makes planetary exploration more accessible to students, educators, researchers, and space enthusiasts. It helps users understand the complexity of Mars and encourages scientific curiosity about planetary geology and future exploration.

Creativity and innovation

The project combines scientific planetary data with interactive visualization, transforming technical datasets into an engaging exploration experience. Rather than presenting information only through static images, RED ATLAS encourages users to discover the planet visually.

Development tools

The project is presented through a web-based platform hosted on Vercel. Additional development technologies and 3D software should be listed according to the tools actually used by the team.
